candidates.title: Theta-coordinate Kummer representations with complete quotient-recovery accounting

provenance_distinction.source_context: Publication of three conversational drafts; source proposal names related PR 750 and pending overlap review.

candidates.proposed_mechanism: Theta-coordinate structure may simplify a complete relation locus after restoring quotient ambiguity, signs, exceptional points and recovery conditions.
candidates.uncertainty: Whether a specific complete presentation is simpler after all lost information and recovery work are charged; the source does not establish an exponent or generic ECDLP improvement.
minimum_definition_gates: Name the exact mathematical object and genus, and an explicit elliptic-to-higher-genus construction if one is required.
Specify original and transformed relation schemes and explicit maps between them.
List preserved and forgotten data, sign and quotient ambiguity, exceptional points and complete recovery conditions.
Freeze a matched baseline already exploiting negation, concrete small instances and the full comparison metric.
source_declared_initial_controls: A representation-equivalence note is the first deliverable.
A quotient with recovery omitted must fail equivalence.
Compare the same complete solution locus with the matched baseline.

ownership.existing_reference_type: prior zero-run ideation input and explicit pending intake note
ownership.thematic_overlap: BATCH-23ec69/TASK-20260905-a6ea8a already covered exotic representations including level-n theta and Kummer/glued Jacobian representations. The current intake source notes explicitly leave this idea pending for an explicit object and overlap reconciliation.
ownership.qualification: Do not describe the thematic representation lane as unowned merely because no exact-ID H/EXP source was found.

candidates.advisory_rationale: Remaining explicit user-supplied proposal and a natural companion to the two selected representation designs; prioritize definition and overlap reconciliation.

candidates.title: Capacity-controlled hitting of low-degree Frobenius strata
candidates.proposed_mechanism: Use the exact killed-chain Poisson solution on tiny reversible lifted graphs to diagnose hitting a low-degree Frobenius stratum, then seek a public local surrogate that biases a walk with corrected weights or a proved hitting bound and recoverable path/map witnesses.
candidates.uncertainty: Whether a usable public surrogate improves fully charged hitting and witness recovery enough to affect the intended exponent; dense exact solutions and hidden target labels are diagnostic inputs, not free deployed oracles.
minimum_definition_gates: Specify the exact chain and nonbacktracking lift, stationary weights, initial distribution and target membership/delta interface.
Freeze the surrogate family, permitted public features and acquisition/evaluation costs.
Specify the biased kernel and Radon-Nikodym correction or alternative proved hitting rule.
Specify curve/map witness construction and recovery interfaces before transferring an abstract graph observation to isogenies.
source_declared_initial_controls: Exact rational 16- and 32-state chains with equal stationary target mass, including bottleneck and well-mixed shapes.
A hidden-label surrogate with acquisition cost omitted must fail the cost audit.
A complete toy isogeny graph is a separate subsequent gate.
candidates.cost_boundary: Charge surrogate construction, biased hitting times edge/evaluation work, correction and witness construction, inverse witness success, surrogate storage and path storage. No exponent claim is validated here.

ownership.thematic_overlap: Not exhaustively adjudicated; exact-ID absence is not thematic non-duplication.

candidates.advisory_rationale: Explicit exponent-facing uncertainty with a small abstract control gate before curve computation and transfer.

candidates.title: Microcanonical carry mixtures for uniform low-weight representation supply
candidates.proposed_mechanism: Count representations x=a+b through a digit transducer tracking carry, remaining weights and run-type counters; choose a target-independent mixture over frozen strata to improve worst-case or lower-tail supply per charged sample.
candidates.uncertainty: Whether representation deserts can be reduced with polynomially many strata and affordable exact sampling/unranking; improved mean supply does not establish uniform supply.
minimum_definition_gates: Freeze the source summand domains, legality rules, integer-versus-modular boundary conventions and ordered-pair multiplicity.
Specify exact stratum definitions, enumeration, sampling and unranking algorithms.
Define the baseline source distribution and choose the worst-case or exact lower-quantile objective before evaluating results.
Freeze the mixture optimizer and training/holdout split; unknown target digits remain offline analyst inputs and are unavailable to the deployed sampler.
source_declared_initial_controls: Exact counts for the specified small m=12,16,20 panel before larger marginal-distribution checks.
Target relabeling preserving the mean and a mean-rich-half/missing-half control distinguish means from uniform supply.
Alternating and long-run targets exercise carry/run dependence.
candidates.cost_boundary: Charge exact counting, stratum tables and count, unranking/sampling, certification and inverse target-specific representation supply. Large-bit marginal checks do not prove pointwise uniformity.

candidates.advisory_rationale: Directly targets a time-memory-success bottleneck for constrained discrete logarithms with small exact enumeration and a sharp lower-tail gate.

candidates.title: Finite-state carry constraints for a prime-field decomposition circuit
candidates.proposed_mechanism: Represent a low-arity Semaev decomposition circuit in radix digits with explicit modular-reduction quotients and carry bounds, propagate joint feasible carry/residue states and retain an acyclic witness graph.
candidates.uncertainty: Whether the complete state remains small once all future multiplier cross-dependencies and witness recovery are preserved; local carry compression alone does not establish reduced full search width.
minimum_definition_gates: Freeze the integer circuit/DAG, radix schedule and cut or traversal order.
Derive exact modular-reduction quotient and carry bounds.
Define the full state and merge-equivalence criterion, retaining pending cross-products and all future dependencies.
Specify witness reconstruction and a fixed small curve, factor-base and target panel with exact integer/mod-p solution-set equivalence.
source_declared_initial_controls: The proposed 12-20-bit prime, arity 2/3 and small digit-base panel checks exact solution equivalence first.
A truncated high-carry control must lose a known witness.
States with identical local carries but different pending multiplier products must not merge.
A random-coefficient circuit with the same shape provides a nearby-object comparison.
candidates.cost_boundary: Charge circuit construction, complete state count times transitions, merge checks and witness reconstruction. Finite panel width/work targets do not prove a scaling exponent.

candidates.advisory_rationale: Prime-field search-width uncertainty with an early exact correctness gate and explicit controls against incomplete-state compression.

candidates.title: A valuation-semigroup presentation of the decomposition coordinate ring
candidates.proposed_mechanism: Seek a finite Khovanskii basis, initial valuation semigroup and certified multiplication/subduction interface for a low-arity decomposition algebra, then reconstruct all roots with base-membership, lower-term and boundary corrections.
candidates.uncertainty: Whether a finite, constructible presentation exists and remains advantageous after complete membership and root recovery; the finite basis is an unresolved input, not an established object.
minimum_definition_gates: Specify the exact ambient algebra, rational parameterization and valuation.
Supply a candidate finite Khovanskii basis and explicit base-membership equations and initial forms.
Define certified deterministic subduction and a termination or finite-test bound.
Specify complete boundary and root reconstruction, including leading-term information loss and lower-term corrections, with construction and recovery costs.
source_declared_initial_controls: A supplied toric toy object precedes the ordinary-curve panel.
A nongenerating basis must produce a subduction remainder.
Deleting a necessary boundary component must fail exact solution recovery.
Randomized coefficients on the same supports provide a nearby-object control.

candidates.title: Isotypic certificates for genuinely nonrewritable Semaev syzygies
candidates.proposed_mechanism: Decompose the generator/syzygy module into invariant blocks while preserving signature-safe rewriting, and certify the distinction between forced Koszul kernels and genuinely nonrewritable syzygies.
candidates.uncertainty: Whether a usable action is compatible with leading signatures and preserves the exact NS(Syz) objects after complete certificate reconstruction; normal-form counts are not a substitute.
minimum_definition_gates: Freeze concrete generators, module action matrices, field and action order.
Specify the admissible signature order and a checkable action/signature compatibility condition.
Define NS(Syz) exactly and supply an independent small full-column enumeration/checker.
Specify rank, nonrewritable-object and reconstruction certificates, charging any splitting-field extension and action construction.
source_declared_initial_controls: Begin with symbolic degree at most four and full monomial columns before the larger exact m=3 scope.
Separate known Koszul kernels from the genuinely nonrewritable objects.
The proposal excludes characteristic-two involution averaging and requires valid charged semisimplicity conditions.
candidates.cost_boundary: Charge action/signature certification, block algebra, reconstruction and field extension. A finite block reduction does not establish a solving-degree or ECDLP exponent gain.
